name: What types of compensation can I seek in a catastrophic injury case?
description: You can seek compensation for medical expenses, lost wages, pain and suffering, emotional distress, and costs for long-term care or assistive devices.

mainEntity.name: What types of compensation can I seek in a catastrophic injury case?

acceptedAnswer.text: In a catastrophic injury case, you can seek compensation for various damages. This often includes current and future medical expenses, lost wages and earning capacity, pain and suffering, emotional distress, and loss of enjoyment of life. Additionally, compensation may cover costs for long-term care, home modifications, and assistive devices necessary due to your injury.
